name: aicdd
description: AICDD — the Agentic Capability-Driven Delivery knowledge layer. Stack- and company-agnostic skills for the change lifecycle: inquire, define intent (PRD), author capability changes, plan, implement, review, steward — plus the capability-map build/verify/freshness skills (project-discovery, repository-inventory, historical-prd-discovery, bootstrapper, enricher, map-review, map-refresh).
